# Brandon Strittmatter

> Personal site of Brandon Strittmatter, Head of Experience & Design at Cloudflare and founder of Outerbase.

The pages below contain readable HTML text; the pencil and paper effects are decorative.

- [Home](https://burcs.dev/): current work, background, and contact links.
- [Interfaces are cattle, not pets...](https://burcs.dev/notes/interfaces-are-cattle/): an essay about disposable, generated interfaces and saved dashboards, published October 20, 2026.
- [Things I'm tinkering with](https://burcs.dev/projects/): side projects and their links.
- [The wall](https://burcs.dev/wall/): visitor notes and doodles.

Contact: [hello@burcs.dev](mailto:hello@burcs.dev)
